hooks.text: 机甲可构筑为远程狙击轻型、导弹步枪均衡型或激光刃霰弹重装冲锋型
hooks.excerpt: Do you prefer a light and mobile mech that bombards their foes from range with a trusty sniper? How about a well-rounded powerhouse who focuses on bringing the pain with missile bombardments and automatic rifles? Or maybe you prefer a tanky build that barrels through all opposition with laser blades and shotguns?
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 每次失败都会带回新部件，且每个零件由不同完整套装的组件重新组合生成
hooks.excerpt: In RIG Riot, every loss is an opportunity. Dive into the garage and check out the exciting new parts you've earned. Every part in RIG Riot is made out of a combination of components from the various full sets available in the game.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 稀有武器与易爆模组需要围绕当前机甲效果互补，形成高难阶段协同
